review.summary: Approve. The PR changes one setting, reviewers.gpt.model (gpt-6.1-sol → gpt-6.2-sol), and adds a matching CHANGELOG line. The Codex author stays on gpt-6.1-sol, so model families stay separate. Tests: 29 passed. One nit: the CHANGELOG line says Astra is not enabled but never says what Astra is.

findings.checklist_item: Plain language: explain each term the first time it appears
findings.title: CHANGELOG mentions 'Astra' without saying what it is
findings.claim: The new line says 'Astra is not enabled', but Astra is not named in review/config.yaml, README or anywhere else in the repo. A reader of the changelog cannot tell whether it is a model, a reviewer entry or a provider.
findings.evidence: Searching the repo for 'Astra' finds only CHANGELOG.md:38. review/config.yaml has no astra reviewer entry.
findings.proposed_change: Name what Astra is in a few words, e.g. 'The GPT Astra model (not configured as a reviewer) is not enabled: ...'. Or drop the sentence and keep the reasoning in the PR description only.
